schema.title: Response List Models V1 Models Get

post.description:
Platform admin only, with a fresh two-factor proof. Refused unless the version passed its
activation gates. The previous active version of the feature set is retired; the change is
written to audit_log by the table trigger, and this API instance swaps in the new model.

Evaluate every staffing option within the bounds for the saved plan of target_date,
store the run and return the options, the Pareto front and the minimum change.

get.description: The most recent run for a date (404 no-scenario).

post.description:
Copy the option's staffing into the plan, recompute the forecast and mark the run
applied (409 plan-changed when the plan was edited after the run).

get.description: Newest first, each row with the forecast for its date (p10/p50/p90) when one exists.

post.description:
A draft for a date on or before today (409 actual-exists if the date is logged). With
`plan`, supervisors backfill a real past day: a final plan is created too.

get.description: CSV export: needs a two-factor check in the last 5 minutes, and is audited.
One row; department admins also get its audit trail.

patch.description: The author edits while draft or submitted; supervisors edit any row not approved.

post.description: Supervisors and department admins approve a submitted row; it is then locked.
Department admins only. The reason is stored on the row, so the audit row keeps it.
